format: Python with Jinja templating for Triton kernel
description: This file is a Jinja template for generating a Triton GPU kernel implementing scaled matrix multiplication with support for different scaling recipes. It contains kernel functions, scaling subroutines, and output storage logic specific to a scaled scaled mm operation in PyTorch's _inductor hardware accelerated code generation.

methods.name: blockwise1xTILESIZE_scaling
methods.description: Computes scaling factors for the A or B matrix in blockwise fashion, supporting different tile sizes for optimized scaling.

methods.name: blockwise128x128_scaling
methods.description: Computes scaling factors for the A or B matrix using 128x128 blockwise approach, optimized for larger blocks.
